Hi John / Acme procurement team -

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) milestones to get Redwood onboarded into Acme's procurement systems so we can move to contract signature and provisioning. Attached is a first-pass MAP document for your review. [Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.docx]

Recap / high-level milestones (owner / target):
- Vendor intake (Coupa/Ariba) - Owner: Acme procurement / Redwood support 
  - Target: 2026-02-20
  - Dependency: vendor form + W-9 + banking details
- Contract redlines and sign (DocuSign) - Owner: Acme legal / Redwood legal
  - Target: 2026-02-18
- Billing & billing setup (banking details + remittance) - Owner: Redwood finance -> Acme AP
  - Target: 2026-02-21
- First provisioning / dedicated capacity booking - Owner: Redwood ops
  - Target: 2026-02-22

Action items from my side:
1) Share MAP draft (attached) and Redwood W-9 and sample bank letter (attached). [Attachment: Redwood_W-9.pdf]
2) Camila will coordinate onboarding into Coupa/Ariba and a short intake call to confirm fields/IDs needed.
3) Dylan is standing by to provide any SOW/billing code or technical contacts needed by your AP team.

Please confirm what additional forms Acme requires (vendor questionnaire, bank letter template, W-9 receipt process) and whether the 2/20 target for vendor setup looks viable. If helpful, Camila can schedule a 20-30 minute intake call next week to run through the Coupa vendor form.

Thanks - looking forward to progressing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. Couple quick notes from procurement: we use Coupa for vendor onboarding and we have a standard vendor questionnaire + bank account verification we require (we'll need a copy of your W-9 and an ACH padlock letter from your bank or a voided check).

Can you confirm Redwood's legal name, EIN, and whether you can provide the bank letter? Also, are you able to fill in our Coupa vendor sheet (I attached the entry guide) or should we create a vendor intake request on our side?

Timeline wise, 2/20 looks reasonable if we get forms this week. If you can send the W-9 and bank confirmation today, we can start the Coupa entry and move to signature week of 2/15.

Thanks,
John
Sr. Manager, Procurement | Acme Retail
john.doe@acme-retail.com
